title: Ship propeller
description: A four-blade Wageningen B4-55 ship propeller, Ø 600 mm, pitch ratio 0.8, 15° rake, its blades from the series' published tables, in polished nickel-aluminium bronze.
process: Sand casting in nickel-aluminium bronze, blades ground and polished, bore taper machined, keyway slotted

difficulty.rationale: Eleven lofted sections whose points are formulas over a published series' table, planes turned to the pitch angle, many coupled formulas and several kernel limits worked round; one loft and one pattern, no G2 surfacing.

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed at the defaults with gaps: area ratio 0.5492, 0.7 R section 1226 mm², four blades to Ø 600, boss draft 2.000°, mass 19.08 kg (−0.8 %), hub cuts exact; it left the root section unscaled (thickness not counted; turn 3 now gives the reach), hub 155.3 mm; its blade-hub union was refused at several range points (F-124); about 314 steps.
